title: IOC Safe Sport: safeguarding resources and toolkit for International Federations and National Olympic Committees
claims: The IOC provides safeguarding guidance and toolkits so that sports organisations can adopt policies, reporting channels and education.
The IOC Safe Sport resources describe strengthening safeguarding across the Olympic Movement, not only within elite competition.
The toolkit routes reports first to the relevant International Federation and, during the Olympic Games, to the IOC hotline.

verification.note: IOC Safe Sport 页面阅读；2026-11-20 去掉两条页面未写的覆盖范围与独立性推断。
